verdict.rationale: Persona is an identity-verification SaaS, and such a product could plausibly offer a natural-language command interface, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only REST APIs, dashboards, workflows and an llms.txt docs index for AI agents. Machine-readable docs are a developer building block, not a way to operate the product with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
